Callout.Name: Suspected Grow House
Callout.Message: Neighbours reporting heat and a hum from a rented house.
Callout.Advisory: Nobody seen entering for weeks, windows covered.

Script.Line: It is a rented house. I do not know who is in it.
I am the landlord. I have not been inside in a year.
There is a smell, yes. I have reported the smell myself.

Lines.Approach: Windows covered, humming all night, and nobody has been in or out in weeks.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
